standing: Leads the AFC East by 4 games

lastGame.title: Bills 26, Dolphins 9
stats: Josh Allen: 27-of-45, 304 yards, 1 TD, 2 INT; threw to eight different receivers and had no rushing attempts
DJ Moore: 8 catches, 91 yards, 4-yard TD; Khalil Shakir 5 catches for 101 yards; Ty Johnson 7 catches for 55 yards
James Cook III: 89 rushing yards and a 1-yard TD, his 10th rushing TD of the season
Tyler Bass: 4-of-5 on field goals (54, 43, 40, 28); a 54-yard miss ended his streak of 33 straight makes
Defense: 185 yards allowed, Miami 2-of-14 on third down, Kyle McCord 12-of-33 for 102 yards; Greg Rousseau 2 sacks, Damar Hamlin INT; no TD allowed since Nov 1

news.b: On Tuesday's estimated report, CB Christian Benford (groin), TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle), RG O'Cyrus Torrence (ankle) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) were limited. Benford hasn't practiced fully in over a week and could be questionable; Torrence hasn't missed a game since he was drafted in 2023. Final designations come Wednesday.

news.h: Rousseau, Brown and Hamlin trending up
news.b: Greg Rousseau, Spencer Brown and Damar Hamlin improved from Monday's report, and Ed Oliver, Cole Bishop, Amani Hooker and Connor McGovern are also expected to play Thursday. The Bills held no full practices this week, so the reports are estimates.

news.h: Chiefs' Kenneth Walker III returns to practice
news.b: Kansas City RB Kenneth Walker III (groin), who missed the last two games, was limited Tuesday. Andy Reid said he was feeling good but didn't commit to him playing. RT Jaylon Moore (ankle) again did not practice and isn't expected back Thursday.

news.h: Bills favored by 3 for Thanksgiving night
news.b: FanDuel had Buffalo as a 3-point favorite over Kansas City (8-2) as of Nov. 23, with the total at 50.5 and the Bills at −149 on the moneyline (Chiefs +126). The 9-1 Bills hold the AFC's No. 1 seed going into the 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff on NBC at Highmark Stadium.

source: Tuesday estimated injury reports (Yahoo Sports Bills-Chiefs tracker, CBS Sports), Fox Sports Thanksgiving odds (FanDuel), AFC East records via Yahoo Sports; earlier recaps from ESPN and AP (checked Nov 25).
